name: @lema017/rsc-governed
description: A governed fork of the rsc harness builder: every distributed skill carries a versioned governance contract and reads the project's own per-skill customization before it is applied.

scripts.version: npm run manifest && git add manifest.json

author: lema017
contributors: Eric Risco (upstream author of rsc-harness, from which this package is forked)

rscFixes.symptom: A guard your team disarmed (.rsc/.no-gitmoji and similar) comes back armed after cloning the repo
rsc doctor reports commandOrphans for skills that are installed, and rsc capabilities shows no skills (macOS/Linux)
onboard fails with RSC_ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE: installed agents differ from accepted policy (antigravity, windsurf, cline, roo, continue, amp, jules, zed, aider)
Stop or PreCompact hook error: Hook JSON output validation failed, and a 'consider compacting' notice repeating after every turn
Security: session continuation context could come from a different git worktree
The 'consider compacting' notice never appears in sessions that edit files through the terminal instead of the Edit tool
Non-technical or mixed users in a non-software project had no guard against irreversible commands; repair wired guards the plan had declined
Re-accepting an onboarding plan erased what init had learned about you, reset your explanation level, or dropped an assistant you added later
Onboarding silently replaced a skill you wrote yourself that had the same name as one of rsc's (review, plan, debug…)
rsc doctor reported missing pieces or an unwired hook but still exited with 0, so a CI or an editor extension could not tell
In a project whose path contains a space, rsc doctor reported every hook script as missing and exited 1, though the scripts were there and the hooks ran
Answers were long and leaned on hidden reasoning, and onboarding asked an accompaniment level few could answer; now: short stand-alone sentences, one question
Pages and screens designed with rsc came out generic and AI-looking, and most projects had no design skill installed at all (found by Carlos del Corral)
